name: Echo Markets

do.objective: The wheel: the plaza ring, then the belts of houses. North is straight on
The north gate is sound-locked: stand quiet until it opens, then use it

intro.title: ECHO MARKETS
lines: A market under the roof of the cave, laid out as a wheel round a well.
Everyone in it is speaking softly. A shot here carries twice as far.

outro: The north gate opened when the hall had gone quiet. Behind it the stair goes down, and the noise of the market stays behind.

messages.speaker: INES
messages.text: A hall with a roof I cannot see. Stalls, strings of lamps, and a crowd that is doing its buying in a murmur. Nobody here has a bell.

messages.speaker: HULL
messages.text: The hall has an echo: a shot carries twice as far as it does outside, and wakes what sleeps that far off. A blow, the arc lamp uncharged and the fork are quiet.

messages.speaker: INES
messages.text: A stallholder throws a cloth over the fruit as I pass, the way you cover a pan when a gull lands. Not at me. At what I am carrying.

messages.speaker: MARKET LEDGER
messages.text: Cord, per length: one voice. Lamp oil, per tin: two. A room at the back, for a night: nothing, and ask no one.

messages.speaker: INES
messages.text: Spears among the stalls. They stand with the butts on the flags and nobody gives them room or takes any. Part of the furniture, like the bollards at home.

messages.speaker: HULL
messages.text: The well is an echo well: a noise made over it comes back from the walls. Keep anything quiet away from it.

messages.speaker: HULL
messages.text: The north gate is on a sound-lock. It will not open while the hall has made a loud noise in the last six seconds. Wait, then use it.

messages.speaker: HULL
messages.text: The west wall rings hollow behind the last stall.

messages.speaker: A SILENT (NOTE)
messages.text: This is the room at the back. Nobody asks. Take what you need and leave the door as it was.

messages.speaker: INES
messages.text: A stair down, wide, and the murmur of the market already thinner behind me. It was a good market. I did not buy anything.

objective: Cross the market, south gate to north gate. The north gate will not open while the hall is loud

quality.introduces: the echo: a hall where a shot carries twice as far and wakes the market, a crowd of peaceful Vael to keep from harm, and a gate that only opens when the hall has gone quiet
